eligible_license.note: Inspected the actual EUPL-1.2 root grant and publiccode ownership fields for this repository. The README separately identifies Profiel and notification services as external/stub dependencies; this grant is scoped to the repo's own source.

primary_evidence.note: README explicitly calls this a Proof of Concept and says the local/test environment uses stub versions of related services. It has functional service source, but there is no versioned product release, production deployment, external adoption or other baseline notability evidence for this exact PoC.

product_identity: MOZa PoC Federatief Berichtenstelsel (message-store and retrieval services)
agency: Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (MijnOverheid Zakelijk project)
family_note: PoC implementation of the official FBS service concept; distinguish this source repository from the FBS standard/service documentation and from the separate MOZa wallet/testnet repositories.
status_note: Hold pending official product release, operational deployment or independent reuse. The official Logius FBS page linked by README documents the underlying service/standard but is not evidence that this exact PoC is in production: https://www.logius.nl/onze-dienstverlening/interactie/federatief-berichten-stelsel.

decision_reason: The exact repository is expressly a test-only MOZa/NL Wallet development environment using fictitious people, mock DigiD/BRP, SoftHSM and test keys. It contains deployment/configuration and build workflows, not an independent wallet product; the actual NL Wallet source is fetched from a separate repository under its own grant.

government_provenance.note: The exact publiccode manifest names the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations as organisation/funder and identifies the repository as a MOZa wallet test environment; README identifies its relation to the Ministry's NL Wallet and MOZa repos.

public_source.note: The assigned repository's public build, container, test-environment and deployment/configuration source is available without credentials. README says wallet source is built from a separate NL Wallet repository.

eligible_license.note: Inspected the actual EUPL-1.2 grant for this test-environment repository. README explicitly points to the separate NL Wallet repository for the upstream wallet's independent license; no claim is made that EUPL covers that source.

primary_evidence.note: README says the service is only for testing with fictitious data and keys and describes it as a local NL Wallet development environment hosted on ZAD, not a wallet application or operational end-user government service.

product_identity: MOZa Wallet test environment and deployment harness (not an NL Wallet product)
agency: Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (MijnOverheid Zakelijk project)
family_note: Test harness/configuration for the separate MinBZK/nl-wallet app and MOZa test flows; the NL Wallet application source and license are separate and must not be transferred to this repo.
status_note: Reject as an assigned software-product candidate: explicit fictitious test-only data and development use, with no independent wallet product identity.
